Must only be used for cleanup in exception handlers. * * @param log the log to record problems to at debug level. Can be null. @@ -255,7 +255,7 @@ public static void cleanup(Log log, java.io.Closeable... closeables) { } /** - * Closes the stream ignoring {@link IOException}. + * Closes the stream ignoring {@link Throwable}. * Must only be called in cleaning up from exception handlers. * * @param stream the Stream to close -- 2.25.1 Provide a response strictly in the following format: Root cause:

Root cause: The original documentation for the methods `IOUtils#cleanup` and `IOUtils#closeStream` incorrectly specified that they only ignore `IOException`. However, these methods should also handle other types of `Throwable`, which includes exceptions that are not subclasses of `IOException`. This oversight could lead to unhandled exceptions being thrown during cleanup operations, potentially causing the application to fail unexpectedly. The patch corrects the documentation to reflect the broader scope of exceptions that are ignored, ensuring that users of these methods are aware that they can safely ignore any `Throwable` during cleanup.
